description: This file defines a report parser class for an analytic account check in Odoo, including methods to compute and summarize debit and credit balances for accounts within a date range.

classes.name: account_analytic_analytic_check
classes.description: A report parser class for generating analytic account check reports, including methods to gather and process account balances.

methods.name: _lines_p
methods.description: Generates a list of account balances and their differences within a date range.

methods.name: _delta_deb
methods.description: Calculates the difference between general and analytic debits.

methods.name: _delta_cred
methods.description: Calculates the difference between general and analytic credits.
